prompt: Create an ultra-realistic graphite pencil portrait of a young Black man in a museum-quality hand-drawn style. Show a chest-up three-quarter portrait on off-white textured drawing paper, with the head turned slightly to the viewer’s left while the eyes look calmly toward the viewer’s right. Preserve natural facial proportions and a composed, serious expression. The subject has short closely cropped textured black hair, smooth dark skin rendered in grayscale tonal values, subtle facial hair along the chin and jaw, full lips, and wears thin rectangular metal eyeglasses with transparent lenses and small highlights. Dress him in a light collared dress shirt with a dark necktie. Use exceptional graphite detail: visible pencil hatching, crosshatching, soft blending, delicate skin texture, realistic shading around the eyes, nose, cheeks, lips, ears, glasses, collar, and tie. Keep the background minimal and softly shaded with faint diagonal pencil strokes, no text, no color, no watermark. The final image should look like a refined traditional graphite drawing scanned or photographed on paper, with high realism and elegant portrait composition.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的石墨铅笔肖像，主体为 一位年轻黑人男性，呈现博物馆级的手绘风格。画面为半身四分之三侧面肖像，背景为米白色纹理绘图纸；头部略微转向观众左侧，双眼平静地看向观众右侧。保持自然的脸部比例以及沉稳、严肃的表情。主体留着短而紧密的纹理黑发，深色皮肤以灰度色调呈现，下巴和颌骨处有细微胡茬，嘴唇饱满，佩戴透明镜片且带有细微高光的细框长方形金属眼镜。身着 一件浅色翻领衬衫，搭配深色领带。运用卓越的石墨细节：可见的铅笔排线、交叉排线、柔和的过渡、细腻的皮肤纹理，以及在眼睛、鼻子、脸颊、嘴唇、耳朵、眼镜、衣领和领带周围进行写实的阴影处理。背景保持极简，并带有淡淡的斜向铅笔笔触，无文字、无色彩、无水印。最终图像应呈现为扫描或拍摄于纸张上的精致传统石墨素描，具备高度写实感和优雅的肖像构图。
